subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She could easily eat the _________ biryani by herself.
solution:
The correct answer is '**whole**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**whole**" means complete or entire. (पूरा)
 
• In the context of the sentence, "whole" appropriately describes the entire biryani that she could eat by herself.
 
• The other options: "**hall**," "**hole**," and "**haul**" do not fit the context as accurately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *She could easily eat the whole__ biryani by herself.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hall (हॉल)**: means a large room or building used for gatherings.
 
• **Hole (छेद)**: means an opening or gap.
 
• **Haul (खींचना)**: means to pull or drag with effort.
